section_summary.extract_value: This Discussion section presents findings from a single study examining relationships between Big Five personality traits and body image in men. The study found that Neuroticism was negatively associated with body appreciation and positively associated with drive for muscularity, while Extraversion was positively associated with body appreciation. The authors discuss theoretical mechanisms, practical implications for mental health practitioners, and suggest directions for future research including examination of personality facets, indirect pathways, and longitudinal designs.
